description:
TaxPulse: Global tax intelligence API + citation-verified US STATE tax engine (California + New York live: R&TC/FTB/OTA and NY Tax Law/20 NYCRR/DTF/Tribunal corpora, machine-verified citations). AI-synthesized tax guidance for 195 countries: income tax rates, VAT/GST, corporate tax, capital gains, crypto tax treatment, expat tax obligations, digital nomad tax stru

Coverage: Global

Endpoints:
  • state ($0.50): US state income-tax answer — citation-verified (California + New York)
  • country ($0.10): Country tax system overview
  • compare ($0.12): Multi-country tax comparison
  • nomad ($0.12): Digital nomad tax optimization
  • treaty ($0.12): Tax treaty analysis
  • structure ($0.15): Corporate tax structuring
  • crypto ($0.12): Cryptocurrency tax by jurisdiction
  • expat ($0.12): Expat tax obligations
  • vat ($0.10): Global VAT/GST intelligence
  • wallet-review ($12.00): Citation-verified crypto wallet tax review
  • wallet-sleuth ($1.50): On-chain wallet investigation
  • wallet-guard ($0.50): Wallet drainer-protection scan
  • verification-stats (FREE): Citation-gate live track record (free)
  • wallet-watch ($5.00): Whale-watch — standing 30-day wallet monitor ($5)
  • wallet-watch-status (FREE): Whale-watch status + alerts (free)
  • 529-check ($0.50): 529 withdrawal & rollover checker (K-12/credentialing/Roth/nonqualified + CA traps)
  • aotc-recovery ($0.50): Missed AOTC recovery — open-window 1040-X screen (up to $2,500/yr)
  • wallet-snapshot ($0.25): Wallet snapshot (lite tier)
  • 529-check-lite ($0.25): 529 withdrawal & rollover checker (lite tier)

account_age_years.description: Roth rollover: account age for this beneficiary

action.description: Which endpoint to call. Options: state | country | compare | nomad | treaty | structure | crypto | expat | vat | wallet-review | wallet-sleuth | wallet-guard | verification-stats | wallet-watch | wallet-watch-status | 529-check | aotc-recovery | wallet-snapshot | 529-check-lite

activity.description: trading | hodling | staking | mining | DeFi | NFT | all

addresses.description: Comma-separated wallet addresses (EVM 0x… and/or Solana), max 5

business_type.description: technology | ecommerce | financial | media | manufacturing | consulting

chain.description: Chain to investigate: ethereum | base | arbitrum | optimism | polygon | gnosis. Default ethereum

claimed.description: true if AOTC already claimed that year (list or single)

completed_first_4_years.description: true if first 4 postsecondary years done before these years

contributions_last_5y.description: Roth rollover: contributions in the last 5 years (ineligible)

country.description: Country name — e.g. Germany, UAE, Portugal, Singapore

expenses.description: Qualified expenses per year (comma list or single broadcast)

income_type.description: remote employee | freelancer | entrepreneur | investor | content creator

magi.description: MAGI per year (comma list or single broadcast)

marginal_rate.description: Marginal federal rate % for nonqualified estimate (default 22)

nationality.description: e.g. American, British, Canadian, German — affects home country obligations

objective.description: e.g. IP holding for SaaS, holding company for investments, minimize corporate tax

prior_aotc_years.description: AOTC/Hope years used before the earliest input year

prior_roth_rollovers.description: Roth rollover: lifetime amount already rolled

scenario.description: Profile of interest — e.g. expat individual, digital nomad, holding company, crypto investor

situation.description: remote work | retirement | entrepreneur | investor | employment

state.description: State code — CA or NY (more states as corpora are ingested)

tax_year.description: Tax year — drives the IRC-conformity era and era-gated rules (e.g. 2024 vs 2025)

threshold_usd.description: Alert on transfers ≥ this USD value. Default 10000

transaction_type.description: dividends | interest | royalties | capital_gains | employment | pension | all

webhook.description: Optional public https webhook — alerts POSTed as JSON

name: taxpulse
